recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Any broader reconsideration of DiagnosticReport and Observation status semantics should be handled under the later status-alignment issue family rather than reopening this completed typo correction.
issue_request: FHIR-11227 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 technical correction for FHIR-core DiagnosticReport. It asked that the Diagnostic Report Status note say individual data items should be final or appended, not final or amended, because the relevant status wording used appended.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit 2de502d0fa9dc02dc27d8e78f7728cb716679637, whose subject explicitly included [#11227] and whose patch changed source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-notes.xml from "final or amended" to "final or appended".
additional_context: DiagnosticReport remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-notes.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-10344 is a same-family Published status-alignment issue for DiagnosticReport and Observation status value sets, but it does not reverse FHIR-11227's specific typo correction. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-11227 found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current DiagnosticReport notes already say that a report should not be final until all individual data items reported with it are "final or appended," matching the published issue request and historical application.
source_changes: No source files changed; source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-notes.xml:61-68 already contains the requested "final or appended" wording.

related_jiras.note: DiagnosticReport/Observation status value-set alignment was part of the same 2016 status cleanup context and helps explain why broader status semantics are separate from this typo correction.
